name: sdd-factory
description: Spec-Driven Development factory for Claude Code: /sdd <issue> drives one GitHub issue end to end - triage, plan (spec + design + Task), implement, a mechanical check plus three adversarial review gates in parallel, incremental bounded rework - launching one subagent per phase, waiting for human approvals without spending tokens, and leaving a learning document per issue. One rule file (docs/constitution.md), one config (.sdd/config.yml), one CLI (bin/sdd).
